ios.desc:
Focus is not just productivity—it’s about creating calm, meaningful moments with a companion by your side.

PurrrrrFocus is a focus timer and Pomodoro productivity app. It helps you stay focused, build better habits, and manage your time across study, work, rest, and daily life. Your Zen-inspired space and soft companion make every session a calm and enjoyable ritual.

Each focus session is more than a timer. You track your focus, earn Treats, unlock companions, themes, and ambient sounds, and gradually grow a meaningful connection with your companion—turning everyday focus into a mindful, rewarding experience.

>>> What makes PurrrrrFocus different?

【Personalized Focus Space】
• Calm Visual Environment: A calm, Eastern-inspired focus space designed to reduce visual noise and help you settle into deep focus.
• Living Zen Scene: Soft Chinese-inspired visual themes shape the atmosphere of your session.
• Gentle Motion & Sound: Your companion moves quietly through a serene garden-like space, paired with calming sounds like purring, temple ambience, and koto music.

【A Gentle Companion】
• Quiet Companionship: One selected companion stays with you during each focus session, offering a calm presence without distraction.
• Emotional Motivation: If you end a session early, your companion gently reacts, encouraging you to try again next time.
• Growth & Rewards: Earn Treats to unlock new companions, themes, and ambient sounds, and make each session more meaningful over time.
• Courtyard Collection: Discover new items and surprises in the courtyard you share with your companion, and watch your little world grow over time.
• Companion Profiles: Each companion has its own story, personality, appearance, and expressions to unlock as your Intimacy grows. You can also give your companion a name of your own.

【Focus Modes with Flexible Control】
• Relaxed Mode: Switch apps freely during focus sessions with no penalties.
• Challenged Mode: App switching reduces Treats earned, helping you stay aware of distractions.
• Whitelist Mode (iOS 16+): Only selected apps remain available during focus sessions, while others are restricted using iOS Screen Time.

【Focus Statistics & Insights】
• Focus Summary: Reflect on each session with a multi-dimensional summary of your time, task details, and earned rewards. Export and share beautiful summary cards to celebrate your progress and invite friends to focus together.
